name: KeibiDrop
creator: KeibiSoft
category: Productivity scripts, workflow bridges, and integrations
description: Mounts remote shared media folders for on-demand editing, with a documented Resolve/NAS workflow. Supports desktop systems plus a separate Android app. Direct peer connections can fall back to a relay; network quality affects editing. Engine is MPL-2.0, while UI/mobile components have separate terms. Paid relay data packs are optional.
